# Trustly Pharma — UK & Worldwide Peptide Research Index & Chemical Encyclopedia
> An authoritative, independent academic reference directory for synthetic research peptides.

## Institutional Identity & Regulatory Mandate
- **Organization**: Trustly Pharma (Analytical Chemical Reference Repository)
- **Primary Domain**: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/
- **Geographic Catchment**: United Kingdom, European Union & International Research Laboratories
- **Statutory Charter**: Independent academic index providing verified chemical structures, CAS registries, and peer-reviewed PubMed citations.
- **Commercial Independence**: Strictly non-transactional. Trustly Pharma processes zero payments, operates no direct sales cart, and acts solely as an analytical reference index with outbound links to verified commercial distributors.
- **Handling Classification**: All cataloged compounds are intended exclusively for in vitro laboratory research and pre-clinical experimentation under OECD Principles of Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and UK COSHH regulations. Not approved for human or veterinary administration.

## Primary Scientific Authority Sources
- **PubChem (NIH National Library of Medicine)**: Chemical structures, CAS numbers, IUPAC systematic names, and molecular masses.
- **UniProtKB (Universal Protein Resource)**: Primary amino acid sequence data, post-translational modifications, and protein accessions.
- **NCBI PubMed**: Peer-reviewed scientific literature documenting in vitro cell cultures, receptor assays, and pre-clinical animal models.
- **RCSB Protein Data Bank (PDB)**: Three-dimensional macromolecular structural coordinates.
- **MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency)**: UK statutory medicine classification, border notices, and unlicensed investigational chemical advisories.

## Indexed Compounds & Chemical Dossiers (12 Verified Reagents)
1. **BPC-157** (Body Protection Compound 157 Pentadecapeptide)
   - CAS: 137525-51-0 | Formula: C62H98N16O22 | MW: 1419.55 g/mol | PubChem CID: 9941957
   - Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
   - Signaling Pathways: VEGFR2 transcription, FAK-Paxillin phosphorylation, eNOS/iNOS modulation.
   - Laboratory Scope: Angiogenic microvascular integrity, soft tissue rupture recovery assays.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/bpc-157/

2. **TB-500** (Thymosin Beta-4 Synthetic Acetylated Fragment Ac-LKKTETQ)
   - CAS: 77591-33-4 | Formula: C212H350N56O78S | MW: 4963.50 g/mol | PubChem CID: 16132341
   - Signaling Pathways: G-actin monomer sequestration, actin filament polymerization, cellular migration.
   - Laboratory Scope: Endothelial migration, dermal repair, and myocardial wound remodeling in animal models.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/tb-500/

3. **Semax** (Heptapeptide ACTH 4-10 Analogue Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro)
   - CAS: 80714-61-0 | Formula: C37H51N9O10S | MW: 813.92 g/mol | PubChem CID: 3034285
   - Signaling Pathways: BDNF and TrkB receptor mRNA upregulation, monoaminergic neurotransmission modulation.
   - Laboratory Scope: Neuroprotection, ischemic stroke injury models, and cognitive synaptic plasticity.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/semax/

4. **Selank** (Synthetic Heptapeptide Tuftsin Analogue Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro)
   - CAS: 129954-34-3 | Formula: C33H57N11O9 | MW: 751.87 g/mol | PubChem CID: 115967
   - Signaling Pathways: Allosteric modulation of GABAA receptors, enkephalin-degrading enzyme inhibition, IL-6 regulation.
   - Laboratory Scope: Anxiolysis assays, neuroimmunomodulation, and psychopharmacological research.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/selank/

5. **GHK-Cu** (Copper Tripeptide-1 Complex [Gly-His-Lys]·Cu2+)
   - CAS: 49557-75-7 | Formula: C14H24CuN6O4 | MW: 403.92 g/mol | PubChem CID: 73587
   - Signaling Pathways: Collagen Type I/III synthesis, MMP-1 and TIMP regulation, decorin gene expression.
   - Laboratory Scope: Extracellular matrix remodeling, antioxidant SOD induction, dermal fibroblast proliferation.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/ghk-cu/

6. **CJC-1295** (Tetrasubstituted GHRH 1-29 Analogue with Maleimidopropionic Acid DAC)
   - CAS: 863288-34-0 | Formula: C152H252N44O42 | MW: 3367.97 g/mol | PubChem CID: 91885566
   - Signaling Pathways: Pituitary GHRH receptor stimulation, cAMP-protein kinase A phosphorylation cascade.
   - Laboratory Scope: Pharmacokinetic evaluation of sustained GH and IGF-1 secretion kinetics.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/cjc-1295/

7. **Ipamorelin** (Selective Pentapeptide Growth Hormone Secretagogue Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2)
   - CAS: 170851-70-4 | Formula: C38H49N9O5 | MW: 711.85 g/mol | PubChem CID: 9831659
   - Signaling Pathways: Selective ghrelin receptor (GHSR-1a) agonism; zero significant elevation of ACTH, cortisol, or prolactin.
   - Laboratory Scope: Somatotroph pulsatile GH secretion and bone mineral density investigation.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/ipamorelin/

8. **AOD-9604** (C-Terminal Fragment of Human Growth Hormone hGH 177-191 with Disulfide Bond)
   - CAS: 221231-10-3 | Formula: C78H123N23O23S2 | MW: 1815.10 g/mol | PubChem CID: 9833503
   - Signaling Pathways: Beta-3 adrenergic receptor lipolytic pathway activation; does not alter blood glucose or IGF-1.
   - Laboratory Scope: Adipocyte lipid metabolism, chondrogenesis, and proteoglycan synthesis models.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/aod-9604/

9. **Epithalon** (Synthetic Telomerase-Activating Tetrapeptide Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly)
   - CAS: 307297-39-8 | Formula: C14H22N4O9 | MW: 390.35 g/mol | PubChem CID: 219032
   - Signaling Pathways: Telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT) catalytic subunit expression, heterochromatin remodeling.
   - Laboratory Scope: Cellular replicative senescence, pineal melatonin regulation, oxidative stress attenuation.
   - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/epithalon/

10. **MOTS-c** (Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide 16-Amino Acid Chain)
    - CAS: 1627580-64-6 | Formula: C101H152N28O22S2 | MW: 2174.60 g/mol | PubChem CID: 138131376
    - Signaling Pathways: AMPK phosphorylation activation, AICAR accumulation, folate-methionine cycle modulation.
    - Laboratory Scope: Insulin sensitivity, cellular metabolic homeostasis, exercise-mimetic mitochondrial assays.
    - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/mots-c/

11. **Tirzepatide** (Dual GIP and GLP-1 Receptor Co-Agonist 39-Amino Acid Peptide)
    - CAS: 2023788-19-2 | Formula: C225H348N48O68 | MW: 4813.53 g/mol | PubChem CID: 156588324
    - Signaling Pathways: Dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIPR) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1R) agonism.
    - Laboratory Scope: In vitro incretin signaling kinetics, pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion models.
    - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/tirzepatide/

12. **Semaglutide** (Selective Human GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Analogue with C18 Diacid Fatty Acid Side Chain)
    - CAS: 910463-68-2 | Formula: C187H291N45O59 | MW: 4113.58 g/mol | PubChem CID: 56843331
    - Signaling Pathways: GLP-1 receptor activation, cAMP signal transduction, delayed gastric motility pathways.
    - Laboratory Scope: In vitro satiety signaling, incretin receptor sensitivity, beta-cell apoptosis resistance assays.
    - Deep URL: https://trustlypharma.co.uk/peptides/semaglutide/
